stem.en: Sunlight warms your skin even though the space between the Sun and Earth is a vacuum. Which heat transfer mechanism is responsible?
stem.et: Päikesevalgus soojendab su nahka, kuigi Päikese ja Maa vaheline ruum on vaakum. Milline soojusülekande mehhanism on selle eest vastutav?

label.en: Radiation — electromagnetic waves that require no medium to travel through
label.et: Kiirgus — elektromagnetlained, mis ei vaja levimiseks keskkonda

label.en: Conduction, since heat always needs direct contact between materials
label.et: Juhtivus, sest soojus vajab alati materjalide vahelist otsest kontakti

label.en: Convection, carried by the solar wind between the Sun and Earth
label.et: Konvektsioon, mida kannab Päikese ja Maa vaheline päikesetuul

label.en: None of the three mechanisms can explain this, since space is a vacuum
label.et: Ükski kolmest mehhanismist ei suuda seda seletada, sest kosmos on vaakum
